description: Escape 2 of the Young's-lattice synthesis (reframe #2 of the 5<->3 keystone, PRs #1684/#1691): test whether the 3-strand Borromean baryon B_3=(sigma_1^-1 sigma_2)^3 is a Markov-destabilized SHADOW of a canonical NATIVE-5-strand object so h^4=-3/4 lives natively at n=5 and the keystone DISSOLVES. THREE forced 5-strand candidates (C-A canonical Brunnian-5, C-B icosahedral A5 dim-5 ell=2 carrier, C-C S5-symmetric 5-braid). For each: forced-vs-chosen status; whether it Markov-destabilizes to B_3 (axiom-3 disjointness); whether h^4=-3/4 appears canonically at n=5. RAW Markov traces from the Jones-poly normalization tr_M=V(q^2)/[2]_q^{c-1}; exact h-expansion via q=(h+sqrt(h^2+4))/2. h^4=-3/4 is a FALSIFICATION reference, NOT a target -- NO fit, NO tuning. Environment: sympy exact closed forms + mpmath RAW substrate eval at compute_dps; engine=python+mpmath.

candidate_A_brunnian5.candidate: C-A: canonical n=5 Brunnian link (Borromean generalization)
candidate_A_brunnian5.forced_or_chosen: FORCED (Brunnian property + minimal crossing determine the object; not chosen for h^4)
candidate_A_brunnian5.brunnian_property_n5: every 4-component sublink of L_5 is the 4-component UNLINK (definition of Brunnian)
candidate_A_brunnian5.why: Brunnian definition: deleting any component trivializes the link. A Brunnian-5 link's 3- and 4-component sublinks are ALL trivial, so B_3 (a NON-trivial 3-component link) is NOT a sublink/shadow. Markov axiom-3 disjointness also fails (no unlinked strand), exactly as for B_3 itself (census #1677).
candidate_A_brunnian5.verdict_CA: FALSIFIED: the canonical higher-Brunnian object cannot have B_3 as its Markov-destabilized shadow.

candidate_B_icosahedral_A5.candidate: C-B: icosahedral A5 dim-5 ell=2 carrier H at 5 strands
candidate_B_icosahedral_A5.forced_or_chosen: FORCED (s5-so3 audit: A5 ~ I, ell=2 -> dim-5 H)
candidate_B_icosahedral_A5.destabilizes_to_B3: N/A (A5 is the SO(3) finite subgroup, NOT a 5-strand braid index; there is no braid/Markov destabilization between an A5 irrep and a braid closure -- different category)
candidate_B_icosahedral_A5.verdict_CB: NOT a native-5-STRAND carrier: A5 is a finite ROTATION subgroup (a fiber group on the 3 color sheets), not a braid index. Re-reading 'natively at n=5' as 'the A5 carrier' contains (2,1) with MULTIPLICITY 2 -- choosing a line to carry h^4 is the SAME fit the keystone caught. No dissolution; same multiplicity-2 obstruction.

candidate_C_s5_braid.forced_or_chosen: the WORD is forced by S5-symmetry; but the DESTABILIZATION to B_3 requires a CHOSEN strand deletion (drop s3,s4), which is a fit
candidate_C_s5_braid.w5_pattern: (sigma_1^-1 sigma_2 sigma_3^-1 sigma_4)^3 (S5 lift of B_3's (sigma_1^-1 sigma_2)^3)
candidate_C_s5_braid.markov_axiom3_disjointness: FAILS (w_5 uses s3,s4 non-trivially; strands 4,5 not disjoint from closure)
candidate_C_s5_braid.but: deleting generators is NOT Markov destabilization -- it is a hand-chosen projection (a fit). z^2 tr_M(B_3) relation invalid since disjointness fails.
candidate_C_s5_braid.verdict_CC: NO canonical destabilization. w_5 -> B_3 only by a chosen strand deletion (fit). Same Brunnian obstruction as B_3, now at n=5.

destabilization_arithmetic.required_if_native5: tr_M(native5) = z^2 . tr_M(B_3) = 0.3748468863893478525864630591537915910515164089747507619828025212866476 (ONLY valid if the two removed strands are disjoint from the closure -- which fails for every Brunnian / Borromean-pattern candidate)

destabilization_test_w5_vs_z2_B3.reading: If w_5 were a genuine native-5 carrier with B_3 as its Markov shadow, tr_M(w_5) would equal z^2 . tr_M(B_3) (two clean destabilizations H5->H3). The large mismatch confirms w_5 does NOT destabilize to B_3 -- consistent with the axiom-3 disjointness failure (the word uses s3,s4 non-trivially).

verdict.C-A_brunnian5: FALSIFIED. The canonical higher-Brunnian object has the Brunnian property: every proper sublink is trivial, so deleting a component of a Brunnian-5 link yields the UNLINK, NOT B_3. B_3 (a NON-trivial 3-component link) is therefore NOT a sublink/shadow of any Brunnian-5 link. Markov axiom-3 disjointness also fails. The 'B_3 = shadow of Brunnian-5' picture contradicts the definition of Brunnian.
verdict.C-B_icosahedral: NOT a 5-STRAND carrier. A5 is the SO(3) finite ROTATION subgroup (a fiber group on the 3 color sheets), not a braid index. Read as 'natively the A5 carrier', the (2,1) h^4 channel appears with MULTIPLICITY 2 (Res^{A5}_{S3}(H) = triv (+) 2.(2,1)) -- the SAME multiplicity-2 obstruction the keystone caught; choosing a line is a fit. No dissolution.
verdict.C-C_s5_braid: NO canonical destabilization. The S5-symmetric Borromean-pattern word w_5 collapses to B_3 only by a HAND-CHOSEN strand deletion (drop s3,s4) -- not by Markov destabilization (axiom-3 disjointness fails, same Brunnian obstruction at n=5). The z^2.tr_M(B_3) relation is invalid; any tr_M(w_5) is unconstrained by B_3.
verdict.overall: ESCAPE 2 FAILS (verdict iii). No CANONICAL native-5-strand carrier has B_3 as its Markov-destabilized shadow: (C-A) the Brunnian definition FORBIDS B_3 as a sublink of any Brunnian-5 link (proper sublinks are trivial); (C-B) the A5 carrier is a rotation group not a braid index, and re-imports the multiplicity-2 fit; (C-C) the S5-pattern 5-braid destabilizes to B_3 only by a chosen strand deletion (a fit), since the Brunnian non-disjointness obstruction is INHERITED at n=5. The keystone obstruction does NOT dissolve: there is no forced 5-strand object that makes h^4 native and B_3 its shadow. h^4=-3/4 is recovered ONLY at the 3-strand B_3 (RAW, verified), and choosing any 5-strand carrier to reproduce it is the fit the discipline forbids. Escape 2 is closed; Escape 1 (geometric / icosahedral holonomy / cusp cross-ratio section) is the remaining non-fit route to the keystone.

caveats: h^4=-3/4 is RAW from the (2,1) block of tr_M(B_3) (3-strand Borromean) and is a FALSIFICATION reference only. NO 5-strand carrier, braid word, or multiplicity is chosen to reproduce it. The Brunnian-property argument (C-A) and the multiplicity-2 / chosen-deletion arguments (C-B/C-C) are structural facts, not fits. No production wiring; L1/L2 dashboards unaffected; no Lean sorry discharged; no LP/SDP solve.
